# Vendored MathJax STIX2

Generated from MathJax 4.1.3 and `@mathjax/mathjax-stix2-font@4.1.3`.
The formula creator loads `tex-mml-svg-mathjax-stix2.js` from this directory,
sets `fontCache: "none"`, and points the dynamic SVG loader at
`svg/dynamic/`. The SRE files are included because MathJax uses them for
semantic enrichment in Chromium.

Do not edit the generated JavaScript or SRE files by hand. The Apache 2.0
license is included as `LICENSE`.
